issue_context.title: [Feature]: add option export CURL from trace network
issue_context.body:
### 🚀 Feature Request

Added the option to export the CURL from playwright TRACE like in chrome devtools

### Example

When you want to resend a request there will be no need to manually reassemble it.

### Motivation

Option to resend / check failed requests.
The option exists in most browsers.

![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/106581694/b7c04a65-cc94-4bbd-9c26-3766f4877017)
